endorsements.name: Zach Crosman
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-35041
endorsements.description: Airship AI Acropolis allows unlimited MFA attempts for 15 minutes after a user has logged in with valid credentials. A remote attacker with valid credentials could brute-force the 6-digit MFA code. Fixed in 10.2.35, 11.0.21, and 11.1.9.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 7.7)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Zach Crosman
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-35042
endorsements.description: Airship AI Acropolis includes a default administrative account that uses the same credentials on every installation. Instances of Airship AI that do not change this account password are vulnerable to a remote attacker logging in and gaining the privileges of this account. Fixed in 10.2.35, 11.0.21, and 11.1.9.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)
